findings.description: Payment method filter slices a single-page fetch instead of storing the full dataset. Reset `paymentsCurrentPage` when filter changes and implement page navigation aware of filter state.
`changeInvoicesPage()` checks `filteredInvoices.length > 0` but doesn't handle the case where status filter returns zero results. Verify behavior or add explicit empty check.
No logic to reset pagination or refetch when payment method filter is cleared. Add explicit check for empty filter value and reset state.
